title: The icon in the sidebar (next to search) stopped working,
summary: Working in the Meridian browser extension project (c:\Users\russp\Documents\Meridian). Fixed sidebar Meridian icon (adaptive SVG, removed destructive dark-mode filter). Implemented persistent pinned Meridian tab behavior across windows. Confirmed Chrome's side-panel icon/title cannot be removed by the extension. Replaced the search-bar icon with a proper 2×2 grid of four rounded squares (final approved design, after rejecting refresh/circular-arrow and a three-column grid). Diagnosed and fixed thumbnail loss on Chrome/window close (tabs.onRemoved was deleting all thumbnails); restored tabs now recover thumbnails by URL. Implemented cross-window tab navigation: selecting a tab in another window activates it and focuses that window, applied across tab cards, keyboard nav, hover-preview, search, sidebar results, and placeholders. Committed as `e73a16f Harden multi-window navigation and thumbnail persistence`. Restyled sidebar search to match main app's CSS pill exactly (44px, spacing, shadows, focus ring, colors) and added bookmark/history toggle icons on the right that switch the list below, mirroring main app behavior. 124 tests passing; source and packaged extension synced. Awaiting user verification after reload; not yet committed.
